channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.50.17 (149)
item.description:
Clearer Library menus

  • Groups actions into Review, View and create, File operations, External apps, and Delete.
  • Uses the same hierarchy on phone bottom sheets and desktop context menus.
  • Preserves all existing actions and shortcuts.
  • Includes safe TIFF export folder creation and launch update checks.
